slots.hypothesis: Round-2 failed core with the toxic '-LogFloatCap' subtraction removed; size/free-float info is reintroduced only via rank-safe cs_last_*/cs_first_* screen positions (implements the prior audit's suggested fix). Mechanism: ts_mean(day_distinct_ratio(Vwap),20) = normal price-discovery granularity level; ts_var(.,10) detects recent instability in that granularity (limit-lock freezes, turnover-structure shifts), per Harris (1991) and Seasholes & Wu (2007).

Intraday minute-return excess kurtosis (tail/jump-risk shape statistic, orthogonal to the 2nd-moment volatility control). Grounded in Chen, Ding & Zhao (2019, Applied Economics) on China's 'realized kurtosis puzzle' driven by retail lottery preference, and Amaya et al. (2015, JFE) realized-moments methodology. All prior archived uses of this core were bare same-day cross-sectional reshapes (sigmoid/cs_mask_top_replace_mean_neg); every seed here instead adds rolling multi-day aggregation (ts_mean/ts_max/ts_stddev/ts_rank) plus a skew-purification variant, continuing round 2's finding that second-order/instability measures outperform raw levels.
